core_obligations: Discharge the forward direction by base-change stability of the twenty listed properties.
Prove the converse property by property, using the general remarks to reduce each property of f' to the corresponding property of f.
Finish the finite locally free case from properness together with flatness and local finite presentation of X' over S'.

proof_roadmap.step: Record that f is the base change of f' and discharge the forward direction by base-change stability.
Prove the converse property by property, reducing each property of f' to the property of f along the thickening.
Finish the finite locally free endgame using flatness and local finite presentation of the source over the base.

difficulty_reason: The statement extends the finite-order thickening lemma to the case where the target of the deformation is only locally of finite type and the source X' is flat and locally of finite presentation over S', listing twenty properties that transfer across the thickening. The proof follows the same architecture as the unqualified case: base-change stability discharges the forward direction as a citation list, while the converse is done property by property, with general remarks reused across several cases. The finiteness and finite-local-freeness endgame is where the new hypotheses are consumed, since flatness and local finite presentation of X' over S' are needed to conclude properness, finiteness and finally finite local freeness. Retained author proof at lines 2658-2850, the largest in this batch.

dedup.scope: Cross-chapter same-name pair compared by hypothesis and conclusion: the sibling lemma-deform-property-fp-over-ft states the same list of equivalences for morphisms of thickenings of algebraic spaces, with Y' locally of finite type over B' and X' flat and locally of finite presentation over B', and it carries an extra representability item. The proposition is the same transfer statement in the two categories, so this schemes-side card is the special case of the spaces-side one and is flagged for the Lead rather than asserted as net new. Compared against all focused-seeds task.json, PREPARATION_WORKLIST.jsonl, and public intervals for more-morphisms.tex.

compared.difference: Hypothesis difference: the sibling works over a thickening of algebraic spaces B in B' in place of S in S', and adds representability to the list. Conclusion difference: none, both assert the same twenty transfer equivalences.
